intentComment: Stories 082-087 - MAINNET StableStaker V1 -> V2 CUTOVER with Antimatter (script/CutoverStableStakerV2Mainnet.s.sol; full detail in its NatSpec). One resumable, state-gated run. Phase 0 preconditions (owners, pausers, strategy map, PhusdStableMinter registration, phUSD minter baseline). Phase 1 retires V1: setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister(V1) -> pause(); V1 is LEFT PAUSED, pauser OWNER, UNREGISTERED from the global Pauser for good (story 084). Phase 2 deploys Antimatter (name Antimatter, symbol AM) owned by 0xCad1..D0B6 and wires phUSD + PhusdStableMinter. Phase 3 deploys StableStakerV2 and pauses it (pauser OWNER, not registered) before any addToken. Phase 4 per V1 token (read live off V1.getStakedTokens): addToken / setClient / idle-balance guard / setYieldStrategy / set-aside buffer copied from V1 / antimatterPerDay = V1 phusdPerSecond*86400*21/10. Phase 5 grants V2 Antimatter mint, V2 phUSD mint and Antimatter phUSD mint (autoAnnihilate is V2's only reward path while claimEnabled is false), with a two-sided phUSD minter-set delta. Phase 6 CrossVersionMigrator + setMigrator both sides; per token relinquish the story-060 principal surplus, initiateMigration, plan every live staker with the dust predicate (credit==0 rides a batch; a credit that cannot deposit into V2 is a named straggler under a 1-cent cap, else STOP AND REPORT), batch-migrate (25 per call, strict-progress guard), post-conditions: per-user loss <= 2 bps + 1000 wei on the ERC4626 autopools and 61 bps (2*30+1) + 1000 wei on USDe; V2 totalStaked == sum of V2 stakers; lockstep strategy principal >= V2 booked; and the EXIT-REALIZATION BOUND min(R,P) + 1000 wei >= P * (1 - bps) on V1's immutable migrationInfo (story 087, audit-33 L-06), which a permissionless V1.userMigrate self-exit cannot move. Phase 7 finalize: buffer recipient -> V2, revoke V1 phUSD mint, V1 retirement backstop, then V2 setPauser(Pauser) -> V2 UNPAUSE -> Pauser.register(V2) -> Antimatter setPauser(Pauser) -> Pauser.register(Antimatter) - V2 is unpaused BEFORE it is registered (story 087, audit-33 L-05); claimEnabled stays false. Phase 8 wiring assertions incl. a sweep that every Pauser registrant is unpaused with pauser == Pauser. Broadcast mode first requires OWNER ETH >= 22,000,000 gas * CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI * 1.2 (story 087, audit-33 L-07). Owner 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6, Ledger HD m/44'/60'/46'/0/0. Order: run :preview and read it (GLOBAL_PAUSE stages, loss-gate lines, ETH_BUDGET line), top up OWNER if ETH_BUDGET says SHORTFALL, then :broadcast, which chains patch -> :verify -> :preview.

variantComments.preview: Dry run against LIVE mainnet: impersonates OWNER, signs nothing, broadcasts nothing, NEVER writes the progress file (preview CREATE addresses are fork-local fiction). It READS server/deployments/progress.stable-staker-v2-cutover.1.json when present. PREVIEW IS NOT THE POST-BROADCAST VERIFICATION (story 086, audit L-02): every phase is 'if (!done) do();' under an OWNER prank, so a step that never landed on mainnet is silently PERFORMED in the simulation and Phase 8 then asserts the simulated state (fork-proven: preview passes with V1's phUSD mint still live, with V2 still paused, with V1 registered and unpaused). Its two roles are the PRE-broadcast rehearsal and, AFTER stable-staker-v2-cutover:verify has passed, a smoke test of the live contracts. Smoke tests (prank only): the user-mandated Antimatter mint-revocation proof (throwaway minter approved -> mints -> revoked -> mint reverts; V2 revoked -> mint reverts -> re-approved), a 100-unit stake/withdraw on every V2 pool, and a 1000 DOLA stake + 10-minute warp + autoAnnihilate that must pay phUSD (a longer warp trips Tokemak's Chainlink staleness inside autoDOLA, not our wiring).
variantComments.broadcast: LIVE BROADCAST. Backs up mainnet-addresses.ts, runs the cutover on the Ledger, then the MANDATORY '&&' tail: patch-mainnet-addresses-stable-staker-v2.js FILLS the StableStakerV2 and Antimatter zero placeholders from the progress file (refuses unless deploymentStatus is completed; same-address is success so a resume leg is idempotent; key-set drift guard exit 3) then chains to :verify (story 086 - the read-only verifier that requires every phase's done-condition from live chain state and never performs a step) and only then to :preview as a smoke test of the live contracts. '&&' not ';' - patching after a failed forge run would write addresses that may not exist. --legacy and --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 are the story-071/073 lessons carried from promotion-ready (EIP-1559 maxFee dips below base fee in a long --slow Ledger session; per-block accrual makes depositFor cost more than the single-timestamp estimate). GAS PRICE (story 087, audit-33 L-07): one env var, CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI (default 300000000 = 0.3 gwei), is exported and fed BOTH to forge --with-gas-price and to the script; base fee was ~0.16 gwei at planning - re-check before signing and override with e.g. CUTOVER_GAS_PRICE_WEI=350000000 npm run stable-staker-v2-cutover:broadcast. ETH BUDGET: 46 transactions (audit-33 anvil rehearsal: 18,317,077 gasUsed; the node's upfront balance >= gasLimit * price check under the 200 multiplier adds the largest late limit, #37 USDe migrate 3,383,096), budgeted at 22,000,000 gas; the script REFUSES TO START unless OWNER holds 22,000,000 * price * 12/10 wei = 0.00792 ETH at 0.3 gwei, 0.00924 ETH at 0.35 gwei (a resume requires the full budget too). OWNER held ~0.00564 ETH at the audit block: TOP UP OWNER BEFORE SIGNING; :preview prints ETH_BUDGET|OK or ETH_BUDGET|SHORTFALL. Without this, forge sends transactions one by one and halts mid-Phase 6 on -32003 insufficient funds. RESUME: the progress file is written in forge's LOCAL pass before sending, so after a crash it can name a contract that never landed - trim it to on-chain-confirmed deployments (run-latest.json receipts + cast nonce), keep the baselines block verbatim, run :preview, then re-run this key; every step is state-gated and the migration re-plans from live V1 state. The script aborts on any recorded address with no code. GLOBAL PAUSE (stories 084 + 087, audit L-04 / audit-33 L-05): the permissionless EYE-burn Pauser.pause() loops every registrant with no try/catch, so ONE registrant that is paused or not pausable by the Pauser pauses nothing. The rule is applied on both sides: Phase 1 retires V1 as setPauser(OWNER) -> Pauser.unregister(V1) -> pause() (unregister BEFORE pause), and Phase 7 does V2 setPauser(Pauser) -> unpause -> Pauser.register(V2) (unpause BEFORE register). The breaker is live for the whole session EXCEPT the one forced tx between V1.setPauser(OWNER) and Pauser.unregister(V1) (unregister requires V1's pauser to have left the Pauser). A halt at exactly that point leaves the breaker dead: resume it before walking away, or OWNER must at least call Pauser.unregister(V1). Every other halt point, including every Phase 7 one, keeps the breaker live and converges on resume. Preview proves the breaker with a snapshot-isolated EYE-funded Pauser.pause() at phase0 and STRICTLY after every phase (GLOBAL_PAUSE|phase0, |after-phase1, |after-phase2 ... |after-phase8 ... |SUCCEEDED); fork tests probe it after every pause-state transaction; Phase 8 in both modes sweeps every Pauser registrant for unpaused + pauser == Pauser.
variantComments.verify: Story 086 (audit L-02) - READ-ONLY POST-BROADCAST VERIFIER (script/VerifyStableStakerV2Cutover.s.sol). No --broadcast, no --sender, no prank/deal/warp: it reads LIVE mainnet over RPC and never performs a step. For each cutover phase 1-7 it require()s the phase's done-condition from on-chain state - using the same done predicates as the cutover's own phase gates - and fails with 'verify: <phase>: <step> not on chain' naming the FIRST missing step (so before the cutover is broadcast it fails at Phase 1). The progress file supplies ONLY addresses (each must have code), the persisted phUSD minter baseline and baselines.cutoverStartBlock; its status field is never trusted. Checks: V1 retirement triple; V1 phUSD mint revoked; V2 + Antimatter pauser == Pauser and registered, V2 unpaused, claimEnabled false; Antimatter minter set exactly {V2} and the two-sided phUSD minter delta; per token V1 pool Migrating, live re-plan shows ZERO migratable V1 stakers (a V1 stake that raced the Phase-1 pause reverts naming the user, amount and remediation: re-grant the V1 phUSD mint, migrate them, revoke again), stragglers under the 1-cent cap, V2 pool configured, buffer recipient == V2, the exit-realization bound on V1's immutable migrationInfo (story 087, audit-33 L-06; replaces story 085's floor, which false-failed on a V1.userMigrate self-exit); per (token, user) every V1 MigratedOut with non-zero credit - excluding self-exits, identified by UserMigrated - has a V2 DepositedFor within the strategy loss bound and V2 userInfo >= credited; per pool, V2 booked total >= (P - stragglers - self-exited principal rebuilt from UserMigrated credits, rounded up) * (1 - bps) - 1000 wei per migrated user (logs via vm.eth_getLogs from the cutover start block in 5000-block windows; CUTOVER_START_BLOCK env overrides); then story 084's registrant sweep and the full Phase 8 wiring assertions. RUN IT IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE BROADCAST (the :broadcast key chains it): the per-pool aggregate and userInfo checks read live V2 balances, which later organic withdrawals can legitimately lower.
